title: Soft banana oat fingers
summary: Two-ingredient baked oat fingers that are soft enough for new eaters and perfect for little hands.
texture: Soft and moist, like a dense banana bread. A finger should squash easily when pressed.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a small baking dish (about 8 x 8 in) with parchment.
Mash the bananas well, then stir in the oats and cinnamon. Let it sit 5 minutes so the oats soften.
Press the mixture into the dish about 1/2 inch thick.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes until just set. Cool completely, then cut into finger-size strips.
choking: Don't overbake: dry, crunchy edges are harder for babies to manage. Trim them off if they crisp.
Use quick oats so the fingers hold together softly.
storage: Fridge up to 3 days in a sealed container, or freeze individually up to 1 month.
tips: Oats are naturally gluten-free but are often processed with wheat; choose certified gluten-free oats if you need to.
Stir in 2 tbsp grated apple or mashed berries for variety.
